INSERT INTO eo_message_archive ( id, sender_id, receiver_id, type, title, content, is_read, read_time, business_id, conversation_id, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by ) VALUES
(#{msg.id}, #{msg.senderId}, #{msg.receiverId}, #{msg.type}, #{msg.title}, #{msg.content}, #{msg.isRead}, #{msg.readTime}, #{msg.businessId}, #{msg.conversationId}, #{msg.createTime}, #{msg.updateTime}, #{msg.createBy}, #{msg.updateBy})
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.sender_id, m.receiver_id, m.type, m.title, m.content, m.is_read, m.read_time, m.business_id, m.conversation_id, m.del_flag, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.create_by, m.update_by, m.version FROM eo_message m JOIN ( SELECT MAX(id) AS max_id FROM eo_message WHERE (sender_id = #{userId} OR receiver_id = #{userId}) AND del_flag = 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN sender_id IS NULL THEN 'system' WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END ) t ON m.id = t.max_id ORDER BY m.create_time DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN sender_id IS NULL THEN 'system' WHEN sender_id = #{userId} THEN receiver_id ELSE sender_id END AS other_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM eo_message WHERE receiver_id = #{userId} AND is_read = #{unreadCode} AND del_flag = 0 GROUP BY other_id
